# Super Mandala Lab

> A free online mandala maker at https://supermandalalab.com. Draw with radial symmetry (4 to 36 slices, optional mirroring), add rings of shapes, and download PNG, PDF coloring pages, cut-ready SVG for Cricut and Silhouette, and DXF for laser, CNC and plasma cutting. No signup, no watermark, free to use for products you sell.

## Tools
- [Mandala maker](https://supermandalalab.com/): draw or build a mandala and export it
- [Mandala SVG for Cricut](https://supermandalalab.com/svg-for-cricut/)
- [Mandala DXF for laser and plasma](https://supermandalalab.com/dxf-for-laser-and-plasma/)
- [Mandala coloring page maker](https://supermandalalab.com/coloring-page-maker/)

## Free designs
- [Mandala templates](https://supermandalalab.com/templates/)
- [Printable mandala coloring pages](https://supermandalalab.com/coloring-pages/)
